2610.08482.title: Knee3DVLM: Dual-Sequence Full-Volume Vision-Language Modeling for Comprehensive Knee MRI Assessment
2610.08482.paper_summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly being applied to three-dimensional medical imaging, but their application to knee MRI remains limited, particularly for interpreting the complementary sequences used in clinical practice. We introduce Knee3DVLM, a sequence-aware VLM that uses full-volume DESS and fluid-sensitive TSE MRI to predict 57 anatomically resolved binary diagnostic targets derived from the MRI Osteoarthritis Knee Score (MOAKS) for structured reporting. We evaluated DESS-only, TSE-only, and paired DESS-TSE configurations using subject-disjoint Osteoarthritis Initiative partitions. In a held-out cohort of 1,074 examinations, the fused model achieved 72.98% average accuracy, 71.17% balanced accuracy, 78.96% mean ROC-AUC, and 78.74% macro ROC-AUC, the highest values among the three configurations. In a secondary multiclass analysis aligned with the released 3DReasonKnee cohort, Knee3DVLM was numerically higher than the strongest reported 3DReasonKnee configuration across five pathology categories. These findings support dual-sequence full-volume modeling for comprehensive knee MRI assessment.
2610.08482.paper_summary_zh: 視覺-語言模型（VLMs）越來越多地應用於三維醫學影像，但其在膝關節MRI中的應用仍然有限，特別是在解釋臨床實踐中使用的互補序列方面。我們介紹了Knee3DVLM，一種序列感知的VLM，利用全體積的DESS和流體敏感的TSE MRI來預測57個基於MRI骨關節炎膝關節評分（MOAKS）衍生的解剖學解析二元診斷目標，以便進行結構化報告。我們使用主題不重疊的骨關節炎倡議分區評估了僅DESS、僅TSE和配對的DESS-TSE配置。在一個包含1,074次檢查的保留隊列中，融合模型達到了72.98%的平均準確率、71.17%的平衡準確率、78.96%的平均ROC-AUC和78.74%的宏觀ROC-AUC，這些都是三種配置中最高的值。在與發布的3DReasonKnee隊列對齊的次級多類別分析中，Knee3DVLM在五個病理類別中數值上高於報告的最強3DReasonKnee配置。這些發現支持雙序列全體積建模以進行全面的膝關節MRI評估。
